category: speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice-agent API, one-time signup credit

free_tier.stated: Free USD 200 credit on the Pay as you go plan with no minimums, no expiration and no credit card required; the vendor puts it at roughly 43,000 minutes, over 700 hours, of Nova-3 transcription. One-time, not a monthly allowance. Rates drawn from it: Nova-3 monolingual pre-recorded USD 0.0043 per minute, Aura-2 text-to-speech USD 0.030 per 1k characters, Voice Agent Standard USD 0.075 per minute.
free_tier.notes: models on the pricing page: speech-to-text Flux STT and Nova-3 (plus Whisper Large pre-recorded), text-to-speech Flux TTS, Aura-2 and Aura-1, and a Voice Agent API that bundles speech-to-text, a managed language model and text-to-speech at one per-minute rate

interface_detail: REST and WebSocket at api.deepgram.com (North America), with regional hosts api.eu.deepgram.com, api.au.deepgram.com and api.in.deepgram.com
tooling: raw HTTP and WebSocket calls with an API key created in the console
chaining: the credit pays for batch transcription of recorded audio, which a free CI runner can post file by file, and for text-to-speech; pair it with a free object store for the audio. Streaming and voice-agent loads hit the per-project concurrency caps before the credit is spent.

limits.value: USD 200 free credit, one-time, with no expiration stated on the pricing page; the terms state that credits expire upon the closing or termination of the account, and that once the initial credits are used a Pay As You Go account must enroll in auto-load or buy…

Pay as you go allows 150 concurrent streaming speech-to-text connections and 45 concurrent Voice Agent connections; limits apply per project, and a secondary project on a self-serve account is limited to a single concurrent stream

binding_note: the one-time USD 200 credit is the ceiling; the per-project concurrency caps bind only for streaming and voice-agent loads

identity_cost.detail: no credit card ('No credit card needed'); the signup page offers Google, GitHub, Azure or an email address with a password; unverified: whether a phone number or an email confirmation step follows the form

reliability_note: after the initial credit is used, requests need purchased credits or auto-load; the credit is tied to the account and expires if the account is closed
confidence_note: the credit, the card-free signup, the no-expiry statement, the rates and the concurrency caps are quoted from the vendor pricing, signup, terms and rate-limit pages; the signup steps after the form are unverified.

evidence.proved: USD 200 credit, about 43,000 minutes of Nova-3, no expiry stated, no card
evidence.quote: Roughly 43,000 minutes, over 700 hours, of Nova-3 transcription. It does not expire, so you can prototype without a clock running. No credit card is required to start.
